description:
Compose a brand-new track from Tuney's hand-made musical elements, fitted to an exact length.

        Use exact genre, mood and tempo values from list_styles, or leave them empty for any style.
        Generation runs in the background: this returns a task_id, so call wait_for_task next.
        Previews are free; downloading the final file costs credits.
name: generate_track
title: Generate a new track
